title: phoradendron mucronatum var. minor
intro: Phoradendron mucronatum var. minor, commonly known as the Loranthus minor, is a type of hemiparasitic plant that belongs to the family Santalaceae. It is a plant that grows on the branches of other trees, obtaining its nutrients by tapping into the host plant's vascular system. The health benefits of Loranthus minor include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Loranthus minor include triterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antiparasitic activities.
